methodology: Two actual built representations share one proxy origin. Both migration directions use real worker scripts, waiting state, explicit reload, previous-core retention, collection persistence and offline summary/comparison/team checks. Standard-to-compact also forces a 503 catalogue install failure, verifies the active snapshot survives offline reload, then retries successfully. Installation uses three fresh contexts per mode, with 150 ms added response latency and shared 1.6 Mbps response-body pacing across all same-origin page and service-worker requests. Media is blocked, CPU and upload are unshaped, TCP congestion is not simulated. Totals are proxy-observed body bytes through readiness, excluding headers and cached browser responses. Timings include automation; these are local Chromium/Vite-preview diagnostics, not physical-device or field results. All individual request logs are retained.
